constraints: Planning only. No service implementation, installation, account creation, privilege change, native probe or historical protected-data access.
Keep each domain's catalog, lineage, save, retention and deletion authority separate. Reuse family-specific ports and established OS/database components.
Headless increment 7 must be independently closable under its separately governed revised scope. No cross-roadmap completion gate may be introduced.
Completed component evidence and all failures remain historical scoped support. New service, physical quota, crash, broker, producer and host claims need fresh exact-target qualification.

Local SQLite and managed PostgreSQL stay structured persistence. Do not put model weights in relational records, invent a database engine or select a new cloud/object supplier.
Use the fewest cohesive increments. All acceptance criteria are agent-executable. Human installation authority is a named gate, never a test criterion or a fictitious pass.

discovery.summary: The app already has specialized object/repository storage, bounded verified streaming, private Context/Training byte ports, SQLite/PostgreSQL metadata and reserve-only Model accounting. Reuse these seams. The fresh same-account original-only parent design has no complete supported qualified mechanism: the final-descriptor layout denied child creation, while mutable construction admits retained-control risks. The user directs a separate app-wide storage roadmap and continued Headless increment 7 closure with simpler replaceable storage. The service proposal preserves the stronger unmet storage work rather than treating transfer as a pass.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Application consumers use existing family-specific ports. A capability matrix states object, repository, generated-file and read-lease semantics. Public contracts accept opaque scoped identities, never caller paths, commands, runtime handles or provider credentials.

Artifact upload and reviewed Context result save use the shared implementation through their own ports. Their present media/size bounds, metadata transactions, review controls, no-overwrite and unknown-effect behavior remain intact.

All reads and writes enforce exact size/hash, finite chunk/count/time/concurrency and cancellation bounds. Captured original operations remain owned through close. Stop, timeout or missing acknowledgements cannot grant retry, adoption, deletion or accounting credit.

Durable byte acknowledgement precedes domain metadata activation. Existing root-owned transactions commit each catalog/binding/receipt atomically. Byte and database effects are not claimed to be one atomic transaction. Exact lost-reply reconciliation cannot duplicate registration or recreate unknown bytes.

Current principal, organization and workspace authority reaches each layer. Cross-owner and missing scope deny before I/O. Public results and audit summaries omit content, secrets, paths, commands and native errors.

Agent tests and independent technical review cover the storage authority delta, malformed requests, resource denial, adapter failure, migration and secure rollback. Document the ordinary profile's cooperative local limits and stronger-custody exclusions.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The accepted ADR and executable policy tests prove the chosen service account, service SID, restricted token/privileges, own-process policy, process/thread/token/handle rights, root ACLs, broker authentication and permitted original clients together. Neither a service SID, PID, executable name, user token nor connected pipe alone grants application approval.

Each finite broker operation binds authoritative current app approval, original principal/tenant/workspace/purpose, manifest/digests, issuance and incarnation. Reject same-account spoofing, foreign clients, replay, changed policy, channel replacement and unknown outcomes before effects. No arbitrary file path, command, general impersonation or unrestricted handle duplication API exists.

On the declared Windows/filesystem profile, actual original create/read/write/publish/retire operations succeed and unrelated peer opens/control/write/rename/delete/substitute/link/stream operations fail as specified, including retained-handle and parent DELETE_CHILD attacks from before construction. Private creator or reader handles and process identity remain continuous. No pathname or final-DACL observation is substituted for capability provenance.

One configured protected pool includes every producer and all five training roles, byte copies, metadata, filesystem rounding, temporary bytes and overhead. Actual concurrent allocation and exhaustion measurements prove explicit bounds. Unknown retained usage consumes its ceiling. Missing or stale ledgers and rollback-ambiguous snapshots cannot mint capacity; exact original cleanup proof is required for credit.

Actual client, worker, custodian and host interruption/restart tests at each durable transition preserve protected bytes, exact ownership and charges. Lost create/write/commit/delete replies cannot authorize retries, adoption, byte disclosure or credit. Recovery inspects only service-created fresh synthetic fixtures with proven lineage; unknown or historical data stays untouched.

Build, binary/DLL/configuration/updater integrity and SCM create/config/start/stop/control rights are verified. Initial privileged installation and later privileged maintenance use separately authorized bounded operations. Ordinary use never silently elevates. Uninstalled, changed or unqualified hosts deny this protected capability.

Broker messages, handles, streams, requests, queue, memory, disk, time and process lifetimes are bounded and measured for the declared profile. Protocol cancellation and service drain retain original unsettled work; resource or audit failure is sanitized and fail closed.

deliverables: Successor ADR and canonical threat-model delta with exact Windows support profile
Reproducible custodian build and bounded installation/maintenance package
Local authenticated closed broker and protected storage adapter
Protected durable ledger using established database/OS facilities
Agent-run Windows denial, crash and physical capacity reports with exact source/binary/environment identities
excluded: Historical protected-tree recovery, adoption, ACL repair or deletion
LocalSystem by default, remote broker, generic file/command service or automatic elevation
A new database, cryptographic protocol or storage engine where existing qualified components fit

acceptanceCriteria.description: Inventory every byte-storage consumer and assign an owning domain, family port, size class, mutability, publication/save gate, lifetime, retention/deletion authority and supported adapter. Exercise artifacts, dataset versions, RAG files, model weights, checkpoints, generated outputs and offload with representative bounded streams. Unknown capability combinations deny instead of silently downgrading.

Dataset immutability/splits, RAG activation/query lineage, exact model revisions and reference-only shared/imported caches, generated result review, checkpoint retention and cached-generator offload leases remain with their existing owners. Deleting a record does not grant byte deletion; storage cannot broaden application permissions.

Actual original controller purpose allocations, approved trusted configuration, protected model/input/SDK/reader/output capabilities and the existing worker pipeline bind to one producer. Complete receiver delivery, independent original worker exit and empty-Job retirement are required. Unknown startup, transfer or close retains original resources and both result copies; no duplicate attempt or Save follows.

The measured shared protected pool reserves original model/input copies, worker results, parent results and overhead before admission. Cancellation, IO closure, worker/Job exit or readiness never release retained results or charges. Only the exact original cleanup owner and proven physical cleanup can grant capacity credit.

The existing cached completion/progress readers review only the exact finalized candidate with base Model, Dataset, recipe, hardware, task and output lineage. Save still needs separate current authorization and an exact metadata transaction. Decline, withdrawal, substitution, unknown commit or lost replies cannot duplicate registration or adopt unknown bytes.

An explicit scoped versioned migration accepts only proven exclusively owned eligible content and preserves rollback records. Unsupported, shared, imported, historical failed or unknown content remains reference-only or inaccessible. Startup neither scans/adopts unknown trees nor moves or changes existing ACLs.

Agent tests and separate technical review cover each domain adapter, cross-domain/tenant/workspace denial, malicious metadata, private-field redaction, retained resources, rollback and failure recovery. No accepted model accuracy or real output-quality scoring is rerun or claimed as service evidence.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Desktop and Managed hosts select concrete approved adapters at composition. Missing installation, changed binary/policy, unsupported filesystem, unqualified physical capacity or missing tenant authority deny the affected capability. Thin clients receive only opaque resources and safe readiness reasons; no root, credential or local path crosses the public boundary.

The existing Managed profile uses authoritative OIDC membership/current capabilities, PostgreSQL RLS and organization-derived byte containment. Actual two-tenant tests prove cross-owner denial, noisy-neighbor bounds and dedicated-placement refusal. Do not place SQLite WAL on a network share or invent desktop/server synchronization.

Agent-run actual packaged Desktop and Managed browser/API/MCP journeys create, stream, review, separately save, read and retain/delete only exact authorized test resources. Test missing service, withdrawal, interrupted transfer, restart and cleanup with the selected profile. App approval/window consent remain independent. Real execution cannot be replaced by a mock or parsed reply.

Authorized fresh-environment backup/restore, upgrade, failed maintenance and rollback tests preserve exact byte/metadata/ledger generations, owner isolation and retained charges. A valid older database/backup does not mint current ownership or capacity. Unknown or corrupt state stays inaccessible. Retention and deletion require the owning domain's exact policy and original proof.

Actual profile measurements report stream throughput/latency, memory/handles, storage peak, queue/concurrency and cleanup/restart behavior against explicit predeclared acceptance bounds. Supported Windows/filesystem/host versions are named; unqualified platforms, managed-native protection or scale stay unavailable. Numeric declarations and sampled usage are not hard quota proof.

All changed threat boundaries, installer/SCM and broker integrity, dependency provenance, tenant isolation, redaction, denial paths, secure rollback and residual risks receive current independent technical review. All transferred obligations have exact owner/evidence links. No historical component or Headless closure is promoted into a service pass.
